programs.title: David Attenborough: A Life on Air
programs.desc: Michael Palin presents a profile of the television career of David Attenborough, from controller of BBC Two to his wildlife programmes such as Life on Earth and The Blue Planet.

programs.title: Life on Earth: The Infinite Variety
programs.desc: Landmark natural history series. David Attenborough explores the wildlife and landscape that inspired Charles Darwin's theory of evolution.

programs.title: Tiger Dynasty: Natural World
programs.desc: Documentary following a pair of tigers released in a nature reserve. They must fight for territory and learn to hunt. Will they mate and start a family, or will they be killed.

programs.title: The Magic of Dance with Margot Fonteyn
programs.desc: Dance has almost always moved freely across frontiers. Margot Fonteyn visits Tchaikovsky's house near Moscow and talks to Marie Rambert about Diaghilev.

programs.title: Ginger Rogers and Fred Astaire: Omnibus
programs.desc: An Omnibus special looking at how the classic Fred and Ginger musicals were made.

programs.title: Puttin' on the Ritz: The Genius of Fred Astaire
programs.desc: A short compilation of clips from Fred Astaire's days at the RKO studio, where he formed an unforgettable partnership with Ginger Rogers.
